title.narrative: Jilin Urban Development Project

description.narrative: The project will address urgent infrastructure needs, introduce best practices, and pilot innovative municipal services solutions to develop Baishan and Baicheng cities in Jilin Province (in the northeast region of the People's Republic of China [PRC]) as livable and resource-efficient medium-sized cities. It will make provision for (i) urban roads and municipal services in Baicheng that promote people-centered urban transport; (ii) the introduction of integrated solid waste management (ISWM) in both cities, based on the reduce, reuse, recycle (3R) principle that includes composting solutions; and (iii) improvement of water supply services in Baishan, emphasizing water conservation, water supply safety, and energy efficiency.

Progress Toward Outcome: The Project will be improved economic growth, resource efficiency, and quality of life in Baicheng and Baishan cities. The outcome will be improved delivery and efficiency of municipal services in Baicheng and Baishan cities. The Project has four components: (i) Baicheng municipal services; (ii) the Baishan ISWM system; (iii) Baishan water supply management; and (iv) capacity development and institutional strengthening. The outcome indicators are being monitored and will be updated with the latest results to be obtained by end 2023.

Status of Implementation Progress: 16.81 km roads constructed;16.1 km of water supply pipe paved;34.2 km of stormwater pipe paved; One stormwater pump station started construction on 26 June 2023; 11 km power line constructed; 15.3 km communication conduit constructed; Some street lights have been installed; 13 km primary heating pipe paved; Traffic control and management system has been completed with domestic financing.Established 20 recycle collection points; 9 MSW transfer stations completed by domestic fund in 2018; Purchased 12 armed self-loading trucks which has been put in use of operations; 30 compaction containers and related equipment was purchased and used. Purchased MSW handling equipment; Upgrade MSW and street-cleaning equipment, and garbage containers and recycling bins; establish 20 community-based solid waste management groups with women accounting for 50% of participants.Established 21 recyclate collection points; Rehabilitate 15 MSW transfer stations; Purchased 15 armed self-loading trucks and 30 compaction containers and other equipment; Upgrade MSW and street-cleaning equipment, and garbage containers and recycling bins. Purchased Road cleaning and garbage transportation, public toilet cleaning equipment, Garbage collection container, transportation equipment for snow cleaning in winter and winter snow removal equipment are all putted in use.5.676 km water transmission lines to Jiangyuan district constructed; 23.069 km water transmission lines to Hunjiang district constructed; the water treatment plant has completed in Hunjiang district with a capacity of 50,000 t/d; 6.3 km existing water distribution line has been rehabilitated; 30.3388 km new water distribution line constructed; 12 flow and 10 pressure meters installed; leak detection equipment advanced; a supervisory control and data acquisition system has been purchased and installed partially; 8.74 km water distribution pipeline has been constructed; indoor remote water meters has been purchased; 85% of 'smart water system platform constructed.Various training was conducted each year during the implementation period since 2015 up to date. All round training were conducted when the project started in2015. Three comprehensive environmental management training were held in 27-28 July 2015,14-15 October 2015 and 6-7 April 2016. Six training and workshops were conducted in 2016. In July 2017, new training on financial management and audit was conducted. A special training on withdrawal application was organized in 2017. The training for NRW capacity building has widely accepted by trainees. The Consultants provided training to the newly recruited construction contractors in Mar 2017. The third storm water management capacity building training was conducted in March 2018. The disbursement training was held by the PRCM in Changchun in May 2018. The Consultants provided environment training in Baicheng on 12 August 2018. The Social/Gender Expert and the Resettlement Expert of the LICs provided gender training on 17 August 2018 in Changchun. The procurement training was held by the PRCM in Changchun on 20 August 2018. The first domestic study tour was organized from 10 to 17 November 2018, which carried out training on urban water supply, road and integrated waste management. The training on construction management and contract management was held in Changchun on 11 January 2019. The training on contract management in Baicheng from 10 to 17 August 2019. The training on O&M for wastewater treatment plant and sewer network sandshort-term, medium-term and long-term comprehensive plans on sludge treatment and disposal on 16 December 2019 in Changchun. The training on construction of spongecity, road plan and road security design was held on 18 December 2019 in Baicheng City. The on-line training on social development and gender monitoring was provided by the LICs on 18 June 2020.The fourthon-line environment training with a focus on occupation a land community health and safety was carried out on 24 November 2020. The on-line solid waste training was carried out on 14 May 2021, covering waste classification and operation scheme of transfer stations, and discussion of problems and suggestions in the procurement and operation of environmental sanitation equipment. In total, 631 persons have participated in the training programs, including 223 (35.34%) females.
